title: TheLonos Challenge Plugin
description: Adds customizable Minecraft challenge pluginto make gameplay harder and more fun.
body:
#    TheLonos Challenge Plugin

  Many more exciting challenges will be added in future updates!​



##   Features​

  ✔ Original by TheLonos
  ✔ Simple timer control
  ✔ Compatible with Spigot/Paper 1.21+​



##   Commands
  
  **/timer start** - Starts the timer
  
  **/timer pause** - Pauses the timer
  
  **/timer reset** - resets the timer
  
  **/challenge** - lets you change the active challenges​


  TheLonos on Twitch
  ▶ twitch.tv/TheLonos​


  Regular updates with new challenges.
  Try the plugin on your server now!​
